items.summary: Improper authentication in Progress WS_FTP Server versions before 2024.0.6 and 2025.0.3 on Windows allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to access sensitive information, including administrative credentials. Update to WS_FTP Server 2024.0.6 or 2025.0.3.

A stack-based buffer overflow in the TFTP upload filename handler of D-Link DIR-505 firmware 1.10B02 can be triggered remotely, and a public exploit is available. The affected device is an end-of-life consumer router; replace or isolate affected units, as no vendor fix is indicated in the CVE record.

JavaNativeMessageDecoder in the inactive Apache MINA 3.0 codec module calls ObjectInputStream.readObject() on frame bytes with no class filter, allowing gadget-chain remote code execution when an application puts it in front of an untrusted peer. The 3.0 branch will not be fixed; use the latest Apache MINA 2.2.x branch instead.

MoLing, a computer-use and browser-use MCP server, does not authenticate its /sse and /message endpoints in SSE mode before version 0.5.0, and a malicious web page can steal the session ID cross-origin and send unauthorised MCP tool calls that can read or write files or execute commands. Update MoLing to 0.5.0.

The Acadlix LMS WordPress plugin (all versions up to and including 1.1.9) allows arbitrary file deletion through insufficient path validation, effectively unauthenticated via a nonce exposed on every frontend page, which can lead to remote code execution when a file such as wp-config.php is deleted. Update beyond 1.1.9.
